audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Deliverance, fear, the poor, angelic protection, speech ethics, suffering, and refuge.

verses.restored: I will bless YHWH at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

familiar.text: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

modern.text: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.

original.text: לְדָוִ֗ד בְּשַׁנּוֹת֣וֹ אֶת טַ֭עְמוֹ לִפְנֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַֽ֝יְגָרֲשֵׁ֗הוּ וַיֵּלַֽךְ אֲבָרֲכָ֣ה אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּכָל עֵ֑ת תָּ֝מִ֗יד תְּֽהִלָּת֥וֹ בְּפִֽי

verses.restored: My soul shall make her boast in YHWH: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

familiar.text: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

modern.text: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.

original.text: בַּ֭יהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל נַפְשִׁ֑י יִשְׁמְע֖וּ עֲנָוִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָֽחוּ

verses.restored: O magnify YHWH with me, and let us exalt his name together.

familiar.text: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

modern.text: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.

original.text: גַּדְּל֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה אִתִּ֑י וּנְרוֹמְמָ֖ה שְׁמ֣וֹ יַחְדָּֽו

verses.restored: I sought YHWH, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

familiar.text: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

modern.text: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.

original.text: דָּרַ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת יְהוָ֣ה וְעָנָ֑נִי וּמִכָּל מְ֝גוּרוֹתַ֗י הִצִּילָֽנִי

verses.restored: They looked to him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

familiar.text: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

modern.text: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.

original.text: הִבִּ֣יטוּ אֵלָ֣יו וְנָהָ֑רוּ וּ֝פְנֵיהֶ֗ם אַל יֶחְפָּֽרוּ

verses.restored: This poor one cried, and YHWH heard, and saved them from all their troubles.

familiar.text: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

modern.text: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.

original.text: זֶ֤ה עָנִ֣י קָ֭רָא וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל צָ֝רוֹתָ֗יו הוֹשִׁיעֽוֹ

verses.restored: The angel of YHWH encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

familiar.text: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

modern.text: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.

original.text: חֹנֶ֤ה מַלְאַךְ יְהוָ֓ה סָ֘בִ֤יב לִֽירֵאָ֗יו וַֽיְחַלְּצֵֽם

verses.restored: O taste and see that YHWH is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

familiar.text: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

modern.text: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!

original.text: טַעֲמ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ כִּי ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י הַ֝גֶּ֗בֶר יֶחֱסֶה בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: O fear YHWH, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

familiar.text: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

modern.text: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.

original.text: יְר֣אוּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה קְדֹשָׁ֑יו כִּי אֵ֥ין מַ֝חְס֗וֹר לִירֵאָֽיו

verses.restored: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek YHWH shall not want any good thing.

familiar.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.

modern.text: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

original.text: כְּ֭פִירִים רָשׁ֣וּ וְרָעֵ֑בוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹא יַחְסְר֥וּ כָל טֽוֹב

verses.restored: Come, ye children, hearken to me: I will teach you the fear of YHWH.

familiar.text: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

modern.text: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

original.text: לְֽכוּ בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ לִ֑י יִֽרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶֽם

verses.restored: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

familiar.text: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

modern.text: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?

original.text: מִֽי הָ֭אִישׁ הֶחָפֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים אֹהֵ֥ב יָ֝מִ֗ים לִרְא֥וֹת טֽוֹב

verses.restored: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

familiar.text: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

modern.text: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.

original.text: נְצֹ֣ר לְשׁוֹנְךָ֣ מֵרָ֑ע וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר מִרְמָֽה

verses.restored: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

familiar.text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

modern.text: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

original.text: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: The eyes of YHWH are upon the righteous, and his ears are open to their cry.

familiar.text: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

modern.text: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.

original.text: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל שַׁוְעָתָֽם

verses.restored: The face of YHWH is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

familiar.text: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

modern.text: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.

original.text: פְּנֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה בְּעֹ֣שֵׂי רָ֑ע לְהַכְרִ֖ית מֵאֶ֣רֶץ זִכְרָֽם

verses.restored: The righteous cry, and YHWH heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

familiar.text: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

modern.text: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.

original.text: צָעֲק֣וּ וַיהוָ֣ה שָׁמֵ֑עַ וּמִכָּל צָ֝רוֹתָ֗ם הִצִּילָֽם

verses.restored: YHWH is nigh to them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

familiar.text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

modern.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

original.text: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי לֵ֑ב וְֽאֶת דַּכְּאֵי ר֥וּחַ יוֹשִֽׁיעַ

verses.restored: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but YHWH delivereth him out of them all.

familiar.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

modern.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.

original.text: רַ֭בּוֹת רָע֣וֹת צַדִּ֑יק וּ֝מִכֻּלָּ֗ם יַצִּילֶ֥נּוּ יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

familiar.text: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

modern.text: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.

original.text: שֹׁמֵ֥ר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָ֑יו אַחַ֥ת מֵ֝הֵ֗נָּה לֹ֣א נִשְׁבָּֽרָה

verses.restored: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

familiar.text: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

modern.text: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.

original.text: תְּמוֹתֵ֣ת רָשָׁ֣ע רָעָ֑ה וְשֹׂנְאֵ֖י צַדִּ֣יק יֶאְשָֽׁמוּ

verses.restored: YHWH redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

familiar.text: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

modern.text: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.

original.text: פּוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲבָדָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יֶ֝אְשְׁמ֗וּ כָּֽל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Poverty and suffering are not moral failure; promises of rescue must not be used to blame people whose suffering continues.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
